title: Constant coefficient of an affine family
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, $c\in\mathbb R$, and $a=(a_i)_{i=0}^{n-1}\in\mathbb R^n$. The affine coefficient family associated to $c$ and $a$ has coefficient $c$ at the empty set: $A_{c,a}(\varnothing)=c$.
replaced: Let $n\ge0$. Let $c\in\mathbb R$, $a\in\mathbb R^n$, and let $A_{c,a}(S)$ equal $c$ for $S=\varnothing$, $a_i$ for $S=\{i\}$, and zero for all larger $S$. Then $A_{c,a}(\varnothing)=c$.
